data.script: Maya: Let me tell everyone what happened, Oliver! … Maya: Oliver practised his guitar until three in the morning. … Maya: So the next day he was very, very tired. … Maya: He fell asleep in the library, on top of a huge dictionary! … Oliver: Because the dictionary was soft! Well… no, it wasn't. … Maya: He snored so loudly that the librarian thought it was thunder. … Maya: So now there's a new rule in the library: no sleeping on the dictionaries! … Oliver: And I have a new rule too: practise until ten o'clock, then sleep!
